programme.title: Leaders. In the center of the game – Karol Czubak | E05
programme.desc: The series directed by Maciej Klimek presents five PKO BP Ekstraklasa players who took responsibility for their teams at the decisive moments of the 2025/26 season. The heroes are Jesus Imaz (Jagiellonia Białystok), Rifet Kapić (Lechia Gdańsk), Radosław Murawski (Lech Poznań), Julian Shehu (Widzew Łódź) and Karol Czubak (Motor Lublin). Cameras follow them on and off the pitch, showing the pressure, behind-the-scenes of matches and their private lives. The last episode of the series is the story of Karol Czubak. For nine years, no Pole has won the top scorer's crown in the Ekstraklasa. In the 2025/26 season, the Motor Lublin striker had such an opportunity. Czubak comes from a town with only about 150 inhabitants. Over the years, he has consistently worked his way to the top. In his debut season in the top league, he had a chance to fulfill a dream that remains unattainable for many footballers. Poland. 2026. documentary series

USA

programme.desc: Two shipping containers containing bananas from the Dominican Republic, containing 192 kilograms of cocaine, are intercepted in Philadelphia. In El Paso, marijuana is found under the hood of a car and an attempt is made to make a controlled delivery. USA

programme.title: Scientific nonsense. 1 p.

programme.title: Scientific nonsense. 12 s.

Dir.: Marcus Rutledge. Led by: Richard Hammond. USA, 2014, documentary, scientific and educational

programme.title: d/s Ice Road (Best of the best)

USA, Norway

programme.title: d/s Ice Road (Under the weight of responsibility)
programme.desc: The police are putting pressure on Tord to remove the truck that is blocking the highway tunnel. While rescuing a truck that has slid onto the ice, Bjorn puts himself in danger when passing cars pass too close. Dir.: Kelly Neal, Kabe Sponberg, Meidell Olsen. USA, Norway

programme.title: d/s Air Crash Investigation: Special (Wrong Choice)

programme.title: d/s Air Crash Investigations (Separated by Crisis)

Dir.: George D'Amato, James Hislop. Cast: Jason Weinberg, Bill Lake, Dennis Akayama, Jerry Mendicino, Hrant Alyanak, Jean-Marc Fontaine, Brendan Wall. Led by: Stephen Bogert, Jonathan Aris. Canada, 2003, documentary

programme.desc: 4,000 years ago, intrepid explorers set sail and sailed into the unknown Pacific Ocean in search of new places to live. They crossed the cruel seas and settled islands from Guam to Vanuatu. Remembering the stories of their ancestors, they became experienced sailors

programme.title: d/s Sea Odysseys: Discovering the Pacific Ocean (Beyond the Horizon)
programme.desc: 1000 years ago, the Pacific pilgrims set sail. For a millennium, no one found new lands, but cleverly made canoes with a double hull “opened” the way to the Pacific Ocean for wanderers. This is how Tahiti was discovered!

programme.title: t/s Lost Bible Treasures (The Real King Herod)
programme.desc: King Herod is one of the most villainous figures in the Bible. He is blamed for the horrific "massacre of the innocent" in an attempt to kill the baby Jesus Christ. USA

programme.title: t/s Lost Bible Treasures (Secrets of the Tower of Babel)
programme.desc: The famous biblical Tower of Babel, so tall it reached the heavens, surpassed all modern engineering marvels. We want to find out if this tower ever existed. USA

programme.title: d/s All about destruction (Crashes)

USA

programme.title: Super Senses: The Secret Power of Animals: Sound (S1 E4). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Anglija, 2017. S1, Ep4
programme.desc: 2017 г. Год: 2017. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2017. S1, Ep4 «Super Senses: The Secret Power of Animals»…Our human senses are pretty incredible – but we only see, hear and smell a tiny fraction of what's out there. There is a hidden world that animals across the globe can experience. In this episode we journey through the world of sound – from the deepest rumbles to the highest squeaks. Using specialised technology presenters Helen Czerski and Patrick Aryee experience sounds beyond the range of our human hearing. They reveal how alligators use low pitch rumbles to make the water around them 'dance', they show what it's like to be a bat and to «see» with sound, and they convert a classic camper van into a giant speaker to conduct the ultimate hearing test for a herd of elephantsIncredible three-part documentary series in which hosts, biologist Patrick Aryee and physicist Helen Czerski, explore the extraordinary world of animal senses, doing various experiments and demonstrations featuring a variety of species. Human senses are pretty amazing, but humans can only see, hear and smell a tiny fraction of what's out there- this series will reveal how animals detect things beyond the limits of our perception. Each episode explores a extraordinary sense in the animal world- sight, sound and scentDirector: Sam HodgsonCast: Marc Holderied, Andre Kotze, Bruce Thigpen

programme.title: America's Wild Seasons: Autumn (S1 E3). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. JAV, 2020. S1, Ep3
programme.desc: 2020 г. Год: 2020. Страна: JAV, Kanada. Год: 2020. S1, Ep3 «America's Wild Seasons»…In autumn, change sweeps across America. As the trees greet the chill with a blaze of color, it's make or break time for animals. Time to pull up stakes, make last minute preparations, and often find a mate before the cold sets inThe wilds of America are vast and untamed. Over the course of a year, this immersive documentary series investigates the perils and challenges faced by the animals that inhabit these ferocious wildernesses. Through winter, spring, summer and autumn witness how the ever changing conditions affect life on land, below the waves and in the air. The personalities and characters of certain animals will develop as the series progress and you will find yourself rooting for your favourites to survive as the seasons go by. America's seasons are wild and extreme posing many trails to the varied wildlife that live there. From freezing rains to scorching deserts, the weather is as scary and unpredictable as it could possibly be. Nature documentary seriesDirector: Jeff MoralesCast: Scott McNeil

programme.title: THẾ HỆ F - GÉNÉRATION F
programme.desc: Souleymane Diamanka (Paris) / Farah Abidi (Paris)Richard Orlinski gặp Souleymane Diamanka, một nhà thơ người Pháp-Senegal và là người thừa kế truyền thống Peul. Là bậc thầy về ứng biến, ông dựa trên cội nguồn của mình và tiếng Pháp để tạo nên một nền thơ đương đại sôi động, trong đó mỗi từ là một vụ nổ mang theo ký ức và bản sắc. Với sự táo bạo tuyệt vời, nhà thiết kế người Pháp-Tunisia Farah Abidi đã kết hợp giữa thời trang cao cấp và trang phục dạo phố. Cô khẳng định tầm nhìn nghệ thuật trong đó nguồn gốc của cô được thể hiện qua các tập XXL, sử dụng chất liệu quý phái, biểu tượng tổ tiên và đồ trang sức dân tộc.
